welcome.text: Welcome to the Hydris console. This is where administrators run the whole field team, from one screen.

command.text: The command dashboard shows who is on shift, open alarms, today's rounds and what is waiting for approval, all updated live.

operator-cards.text: Each operator on shift has a card with their site, their device and its battery.

live-view.text: When glasses are streaming, you see what the operator sees, right here on the card. Open it for the full device view.

go-operators.text: Now click Operators in the sidebar to continue.

operators.text: Invite operators by email, edit their shifts and sites, and suspend or remove access in one click. Every change lands in the audit log.

devices.text: Devices lists every pair of glasses and every phone. Pairing uses a short single use code, and your device policy decides who must approve new devices.

work.text: Plan the work here. Build inspection rounds and maintenance tasks, then assign them to an operator or a crew.

approvals.text: Approvals collects everything that needs a second pair of eyes. Scanned audit sheets are verified by two people, then saved as Word and PDF soft copies.

telemetry.text: Plant and telemetry show every asset and sensor, with live trends and alarm limits.

reports.text: Reports turn the field record into compliance evidence and performance trends that you can search and export.

closing.text: That is the Hydris console. Hydris advises and records, and your operators stay in control of the equipment. Thank you for watching.
